sources.entry: Flagsmith - Dashboard, API and SDKs for adding Feature Flags to your applications (alternative to LaunchDarkly). (Source Code) BSD-3-Clause Docker/K8S
Flagsmith | Feature flag and remote config service

summary.one_liner: Flagsmith is an open-source feature flag and remote configuration platform with a dashboard, API, and SDKs for toggling features and running experiments without redeploying code.
summary.what_it_does: Provides a web dashboard and API for creating feature flags and remote config values that can be toggled per environment, user, or segment. Supports segments for beta releases and A/B or multivariate tests, plus organisations, projects, and roles for team management. Client and server SDKs are listed for many languages and frameworks, including JavaScript, React, Next.js, Python, Java, .NET, Go, and Rust. It also offers an OpenFeature route with providers for several languages and an MCP server, according to the README. The README says it can be self-hosted with a free open-source build or an Enterprise edition, and also mentions private cloud and hosted cloud options.
use_cases: roll out features behind feature flags
how_to_run: curl -o docker-compose.yml (URL missing from README text)
stack: Python, Java, .NET, Go, Rust, Ruby, PHP, Node.js, Elixir SDKs
notable: Open-source core under BSD-3-Clause with a free self-hosted build
Works with OpenFeature providers to avoid vendor lock-in
Segments and multivariate tests for experimentation
Broad SDK coverage across client and server languages
Includes an MCP server integration according to the README
caveats: Enterprise-level governance and management features require a paid Flagsmith Enterprise license
Client-side environment keys must be used in browser code; server-side keys must stay secret
The README's docker-compose download URL and the 'open http' address are missing from the text, so setup steps are incomplete
